lines.text: Many learners say: I get up at 7 morning.
Better: I get up at 7 in the morning.
Say in the morning after the time.
In the morning! I wake up at 7 in the morning.

data.right: I get up at 7 in the morning.
data.why: Say in the morning after the time.
